name: Aiman Zulkifli
bio:
Aiman's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in composite materials. After graduating, he gained experience at a local automotive firm, working on carbon fiber components. Eager to apply his knowledge to the high-stakes world of racing, he actively sought opportunities within motorsport.

Aiman is a highly methodical technician, meticulously following procedures and adhering to strict quality control standards. He is known for his creative problem-solving skills, often devising innovative solutions to complex challenges. His detail-oriented approach ensures that every composite component meets the demanding requirements of a racing environment.

While demanding, Aiman's pursuit of perfection ensures the highest standards in composite engineering. He approaches every challenge as an opportunity to improve and innovate.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a lean, athletic build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of carbon fiber resin.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
